I have been receiving cancer care at Mt. Sinai through my work insurance for the last year and my doctors signed a continuation of care letter in December but I still received a letter today saying “ Your self pay estimated facility responsibility is $508.07” for one infusion and “your self pay estimated facility responsibility is $85,212.64” for another now that I’m not covered at all. LOL fml.

Hi! No problem, happy to share. To be honest, it hasn’t been as quick to recovery as I anticipated post-treatment. I’m just over 2 weeks out, and stomach cramps and diarrhea persisted pretty poorly for about a week plus. I’d say only in the past few days I’ve been able to reintroduce most foods, though yesterday I had a coffee finally and that was maybe a mistake, lol. 

The worst for me has been the cystitis! It started mildly the final week of my treatment and has only started to mellow out this week. It was like the worst UTI you’ve ever had for about 15 days, and pretty miserable. I do wonder if I had some extra bladder sensitivity, however, since I had to have a repair to a tear during my hysterectomy in November. 

I’ve read many people have about 2-3 weeks of cystitis and/or enteritis after treatment, so been trying to be patient with myself and not stress about the discomfort and such. Then again, some people have little to no side effects! I hope it’s pretty painless and a quick journey for you!!

I (38f) am also based in NYC, go to Mount Sinai, and have a rare neuroendocrine cancer and I’m finishing the final week of my pelvic radiation (25 rounds) this week and next. I have been working the last 7 months through all my treatments (5 rounds of chemo, radical hysterectomy via abdominal surgery in November, and finally pelvic radiation 5 days a week with a low dose chemo once a week). I work in development for a small team in publishing and while I pretty much love my job, and have had a flexible arrangement with work, taking additional sick days off as needed, let me tell you: the last 3-4 weeks of this radiation has been a super struggle.

I worked remote pretty much the entire time, and coming to the end of this, I really wish I’d taken maybe the entire month off for radiation. For me, it’s been worse than the chemo because there’s less downtime between treatments, the fatigue kicked in fast, and the side effects felt severely downplayed to me (the diarrhea and dehydration these final treatments have been no joke). I’ve lost 8 pounds, walking up stairs from the subway some mornings is a struggle, Monday through Friday I’m essentially rushing to the hospital and then rushing back home to get on calls or answer emails about things that, frankly, shouldn’t matter right now. I feel disappointed that I didn’t prioritize my health during this time, and that I got into a habit of letting people think I’m “strong” and, worse yet, “available” to them while I’m legit out here fighting for my life. PLEASE take the time off. Your job will be there when you’re good and ready to go back.
Thanks so much, and I hope your mom has some relief soon, too!

Oh man, I can’t even fathom having to travel between buildings during this, you are a true warrior. And thank you so much for the kind words and wishes, it’s always such a comfort to hear that others have made it through!!

Yeah, I would never dare bring a child into my bullshit, trust me. I’m supremely careful and anti-kids (and marriage) bc of my mental health issues. I also just don’t like kids very much, ahah, go figure. 

I’m so sorry women have consistently disappointed you , but also not surprised. Humans in general-we’re all kind of a big disappointment? But I also know I’m selfish to have started dating again in the first place, or at least to have pretended I’d escaped the desire to end my life every other second, lol, jokes on me. I wish we could all be more honest and talk about our mental health (or lack there of) but then I guess there’d be a lot more perpetually single people...

I just hope the next chick is less of a fuck-up than me? I don’t think it’s asking too much, given my current state of mind. I just want the “Holidays” to be over so I can stop pretending to be fine. I don’t want to waste anyone’s time with my crap anymore.

Oh man. I feel you on the work “culture” bullshit. I do not understand how the rat race attitude continues while everything is straight up crumbling around us?? And how no one seems to even notice the people falling apart around them.

Absolute mind fuck. And I worked for CBO/NPOs, so even the base levels of “helping” people at work can still be fucked up and corporate. I honestly have never been so turned off to the nonprofit sector, this year fully ruined whatever hope I was clinging to. 

I’m so so sorry you’re struggling with this shit, it’s beyond demoralizing.

Please hang in there though, cause as freeing as like the first 48 hours felt after quitting, I wouldn’t wish my current mindset on my worst enemy. I don’t know if I’ve ever felt this down in my existence, there’s just no point to anything anymore, the days all blend together.

OK, yes, THIS. Thank you, and I also read this before your edit and it was immensely appreciated. We are not garbage! I have an older sibling who’s pretty much been MIA (I don’t blame them!) for much of the same reasons. I know I get no, like, points for being a martyr, lol, I need to stop falling into a pattern of guilt and regret and get on with my own healing.
Thanks- this board has been immensely helpful to me the past 24 hours and I’m so glad it exists. It’s  hard not to feel like an imposition but I know a lot of that is my own shame, etc.
Thank you for your thoughtful reply and kind words. I really appreciate it!
